environment.description: EKS pod in us-east-1 VPC with standard NAT gateway egress. Pod service account has IAM role with s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on 'arn:aws:s3:::*'. No VPC endpoint for S3 configured - traffic routes through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint. No network policy restricting pod egress. gRPC port 50051 exposed via internal NLB with no authentication layer.
